topics.fa_def: سازمان پایه‌ای قوه‌ی قضاییه؛ گاه تنها بالاترین دادگاه را برپا می‌کند و سازمان‌دهی بقیه را به قانون عادی می‌سپارد.

topics.definition_en: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained to be eligible to serve as a representative in the first chamber of the legislature. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
topics.question: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of the first (or only) chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن نمایندگی در مجلس نخست و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Names the office that presides over the first chamber of the legislature. This function might be fulfilled by the head of government, a member of the chamber, the deputy executive, or another official.
topics.question: Who presides over the first (or only) chamber?
topics.fa_def: مقامی را که ریاست مجلس نخست را بر عهده دارد تعیین می‌کند: رئیس دولت، یکی از نمایندگان، معاون رئیس قوه‌ی مجریه یا مقامی دیگر.

topics.definition_en: Specifies the proportion of the seats in the first chamber that must be assigned to representatives of a particular group, such as women, ethnic groups, political parties, religious groups, or social classes.
topics.question: Does the constitution stipulate a quota for representation of certain groups in the first (or only) chamber?
topics.fa_def: نسبتی از کرسی‌های مجلس نخست که باید به نمایندگان گروهی معین، مانند زنان، گروه‌های قومی یا دینی، احزاب یا طبقات اجتماعی برسد.

topics.definition_en: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a representative in the first chamber of the legislature. These often concern residency, proficiency in the official language, or prior occupation.
topics.question: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of the first (or only) chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شرایطی که نامزد نمایندگی مجلس نخست باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی اقامت، تسلط بر زبان رسمی یا پیشه‌ی پیشین.

topics.definition_en: The total number of seats in the first chamber of the legislature.
topics.question: How many members compose the first (or only) chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شمار کل کرسی‌های مجلس نخست.

topics.definition_en: Describes the procedure through which members of the first chamber of the legislature are elected or appointed.
topics.question: How are members of the first (or only) chamber of the legislature selected?
topics.fa_def: روال انتخاب یا انتصاب اعضای مجلس نخست.

topics.definition_en: Names specific areas of legislation that are a special concern for the first chamber. This may include sole authority to legislate in these areas.
topics.question: In regards to specific policy/substantive areas of legislation, are there any restrictions on, or special privileges reserved for, the first (or only) chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: حوزه‌هایی از قانون‌گذاری که به‌طور ویژه بر عهده‌ی مجلس نخست است، گاه با اختیار انحصاری.

topics.definition_en: The number of years that a representative in the first chamber of the legislature serves before reelection, reappointment, or dismissal is required.
topics.question: What is the maximum term length for members of the first (or only) chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شمار سال‌هایی که نماینده‌ی مجلس نخست پیش از انتخاب یا انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری خدمت می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a representative in the first chamber of the legislature.
topics.question: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms members of the first (or only) chamber may serve?
topics.fa_def: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند نماینده‌ی مجلس نخست باشد.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to defend themselves against libel or slander. Understood in the context of freedom of expression, this may not include prior censorship, allowing instead for legal remedy after the fact.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right of protection of one's reputation from libelous actions?
topics.fa_def: حق دفاع در برابر افترا یا هتک حرمت؛ در کنار آزادی بیان، معمولن به معنای جبران قانونی پس از رخداد است، نه سانسور پیشین.

topics.definition_en: Establishes a right to life. The precise meaning of this provision varies between jurisdictions, and may or may not be a reference to the unborn.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to life?
topics.fa_def: حق زندگی را مقرر می‌کند؛ معنای دقیق آن در نظام‌های گوناگون فرق می‌کند و ممکن است جنین را هم در بر بگیرد یا نگیرد.

topics.definition_en: Regulates marriage, including granting the right to marry and establishing rules regarding divorce. May include a definition of marriage, and may or may not be limited to heterosexual couples.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right to marry?
topics.fa_def: قواعد ازدواج، از جمله حق ازدواج و احکام طلاق؛ ممکن است تعریفی از ازدواج بدهد که به زن و مرد محدود باشد یا نباشد.

topics.definition_en: Gives both spouses the same rights in marriage and family law. This is a separate issue from the general guarantee of gender equality.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for matrimonial equality?
topics.fa_def: به هر دو همسر حقوق یکسان در ازدواج و حقوق خانواده می‌دهد؛ این موضوع جدا از تضمین کلی برابری جنسیتی است.

topics.definition_en: Establishes a commission to regulate mass media. This may include ensuring free expression, and in some cases enforcing some form of censorship.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention a special regulatory body/institution to oversee the media market?
topics.fa_def: کمیسیونی برای تنظیم رسانه‌های همگانی، که ممکن است آزادی بیان را پاس بدارد یا گونه‌ای سانسور را اعمال کند.

topics.definition_en: The selection process for the highest ranking officers in the military. This often involves appointment by the head of the executive branch, and in some cases also requires the approval of at least part of the legislature.
topics.question: What is the procedure for appointing and dismissing active-duty commanders in the military?
topics.fa_def: روال گزینش بلندپایه‌ترین افسران، که اغلب با انتصاب رئیس قوه‌ی مجریه و گاه با تایید مجلس است.

topics.definition_en: Limitations either on the government's use of the military, or on the actions of members of the military. For example, prohibition of domestic deployment of the military, or restrictions on the political rights of military officers.
topics.question: Are there any specific restrictions on the armed forces?
topics.fa_def: محدودیت بر کاربرد ارتش از سوی حکومت یا بر رفتار نظامیان، مانند منع به‌کارگیری ارتش در داخل کشور یا محدودیت حقوق سیاسی افسران.

topics.en: Duty to serve in the military
topics.definition_en: A duty to serve a specified period of time in the country's military. Often also includes protections for conscientious objectors.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to a duty of military service?
topics.fa_def: وظیفه‌ی خدمت در ارتش برای مدتی معین، اغلب همراه با حمایت از معترضان وجدانی.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to forego answering questions during an interrogation or in court that would tend to confirm the individual's guilt. In some cases an individual may waive this right if they so choose.
topics.question: Does the constitution give the accused a right to silence or protection from self incrimination?
topics.fa: منع اجبار به اقرار علیه خود
topics.fa_def: حق خودداری از پاسخ به پرسش‌هایی در بازجویی یا دادگاه که مجرمیت فرد را تایید می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Frames the constitution in a particular context. Often a response to the country's recent history.
topics.question: What motives, if any, does the constitution identify for writing the document?
topics.fa_def: قانون اساسی را در بستری معین می‌نشاند، اغلب در پاسخ به تاریخ نزدیک کشور.

topics.definition_en: Affirms the national motto, sometimes in more than one language.
topics.question: Does the constitution contain a national motto?
topics.fa_def: شعار ملی کشور را، گاه به بیش از یک زبان، اعلام می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Establishes the organs of municipal or local government, and their competencies.
topics.question: What organs are included in the local/municipal government?
topics.fa_def: ارکان حکومت شهری یا محلی و صلاحیت‌های آن‌ها را برپا می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Naturalization is the process through which a person acquires a citizenship to which they did not have a right by birth. These provisions detail the requirements an individual must fulfil in order to gain citizenship.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for naturalized citizens?
topics.fa_def: شرایطی که فرد برای به دست آوردن تابعیتی که به‌سبب تولد نداشته است باید فراهم کند.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals whose religious or ethical beliefs prevent them from participating in war an exemption from military service.
topics.question: Who has the power to declare war?
topics.fa_def: کسانی که باور دینی یا اخلاقی‌شان مانع شرکت در جنگ است از خدمت نظامی معاف می‌شوند.

topics.definition_en: Requires certain public office holders to take an oath to support or abide by the constitution.
topics.question: Does the constitution stipulate that some public office holders take an oath to support or abide by the constitution?
topics.fa_def: برخی مقام‌های عمومی باید به پشتیبانی یا پایبندی به قانون اساسی سوگند بخورند.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the freedom to choose their occupation and their place of employment without interference from the government.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right to choose ones occupation?
topics.fa_def: آزادی انتخاب شغل و محل کار بی‌دخالت حکومت.

topics.definition_en: Establishment of an official religion, or religions, for the state. Other constitutions provide special treatment for certain religions, or conversely, expressly forbid the state from establishing an official religion.
topics.question: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning a national or official religion or a national or official church?
topics.fa_def: تعیین دین یا دین‌های رسمی کشور؛ برخی قانون‌های اساسی به دین‌هایی جایگاه ویژه می‌دهند یا برعکس، رسمی کردن دین را صریحن منع می‌کنند.

topics.definition_en: A public official tasked with investigating improper or illegal actions on the part of government agencies which may infringe on the rights of individuals. Enables individuals to bring complaints about the actions of the government.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for an ombudsman?
topics.fa_def: مقامی عمومی برای تحقیق درباره‌ی کارهای نادرست یا غیرقانونی دستگاه‌های حکومتی که به حقوق افراد آسیب می‌زند، و راهی برای شکایت مردم از حکومت.

topics.definition_en: The state is required to provide additional resources, either in monetary contributions or in services, to specific groups within the society. Categories might include gender, ethnicity, disability, or any other group identity.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for positive obligations to transfer wealth to, or provide opportunity for, particular groups?
topics.fa_def: دولت باید به گروه‌هایی معین، بر پایه‌ی جنسیت، قومیت، معلولیت یا هویت گروهی دیگر، منابع یا خدمات بیش‌تری بدهد.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to believe or think anything they find compelling. This does not necessarily mean that they have a right to express these beliefs.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for freedom of opinion, thought, and/or conscience?
topics.fa_def: حق افراد برای باور داشتن یا اندیشیدن به هر چه درست می‌دانند؛ این لزومن به معنای حق بیان آن باورها نیست.

topics.en: Age restrictions on ordinary court judges
topics.definition_en: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of judge in an ordinary court. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
topics.question: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of ordinary courts?
topics.fa_def: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی قضاوت در دادگاه عادی و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a judge in an ordinary court. These often concern educational and professional credentials.
topics.question: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of ordinary courts?
topics.fa: شرایط احراز قضاوت در دادگاه‌های عادی
topics.fa_def: شرایطی که قاضی دادگاه عادی باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی تحصیلات و سابقه‌ی حرفه‌ای.

topics.definition_en: The procedure through which a candidate for an ordinary court judgeship is nominated and approved.  This might involve approval from the executive, and all or part of the legislature.
topics.question: Who is involved in the nomination of judges to ordinary courts?
topics.fa_def: روال نامزدی و تایید قاضی دادگاه عادی، که ممکن است به تایید قوه‌ی مجریه و همه یا بخشی از مجلس نیاز داشته باشد.

topics.definition_en: The number of years that an ordinary court judge serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
topics.question: What is the maximum term length for judges for ordinary courts?
topics.fa_def: شمار سال‌های خدمت قاضی دادگاه عادی پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.

topics.definition_en: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a judge in an ordinary court.
topics.question: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms members of the ordinary court may serve?
topics.fa_def: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند قاضی دادگاه عادی باشد.

topics.definition_en: Special legislative processes for organic laws, which may include restrictions on proposal, approval, or amendment. Organic laws establish fundamental aspects of the constitutional order, including establishing institutions like the courts or legislature, and in some jurisdictions are accorded similar status to the constitution itself. They sometimes require a higher standard for approval than ordinary law.
topics.question: Who initiates organic or basic law?
topics.fa_def: روال ویژه‌ی قانون‌گذاری برای قوانین ارگانیک، که ارکان بنیادین نظم قانون اساسی مانند دادگاه‌ها یا مجلس را برپا می‌کنند، گاه هم‌پایه‌ی قانون اساسی‌اند و تصویبشان به اکثریت بالاتری نیاز دارد.

topics.definition_en: Allows the legislature to take additional steps to pass legislation that has been vetoed by the actor responsible for approving or rejecting legislation. This typically requires a supermajority, but there is some variation.
topics.question: Can vetoes of legislation be overridden?
topics.fa_def: امکان تصویب دوباره‌ی قانونی که وتو شده است، معمولن با اکثریت ویژه.

topics.definition_en: Grants citizens the right to overthrow the government under certain circumstances. This right is usually expressed in terms of defending the constitutional order, rather than establishing a new one.
topics.question: Does the constitution suggest that citizens should have the right to overthrow their government under certain circumstances?
topics.fa_def: حق شهروندان برای سرنگونی حکومت در شرایط معین، که معمولن به‌صورت دفاع از نظم قانون اساسی بیان می‌شود، نه برپایی نظمی تازه.

topics.definition_en: Gives a body within the executive branch the authority to overrule a criminal conviction.
topics.question: Does the head of state have the power to pardon?
topics.fa_def: به نهادی در قوه‌ی مجریه اختیار می‌دهد محکومیت کیفری را ببخشد یا لغو کند.

topics.definition_en: Grants parents certain rights or duties regarding their children. May include the duty to provide for one's legal children, or the right to make decisions about their education, upbringing, and other aspects of their lives.
topics.fa_def: حقوق یا وظایف والدین در برابر فرزندان، مانند وظیفه‌ی تامین معاش فرزندان یا حق تصمیم‌گیری درباره‌ی آموزش و تربیت آنان.

topics.definition_en: A particular political party, or type of party, has a special status within the state.
topics.question: Does the constitution express a preference for one or more political parties?
topics.fa_def: حزبی یا گونه‌ای از احزاب جایگاهی ویژه در کشور دارد.

topics.definition_en: Certain political parties, or parties with particular ideologies or characteristics, are prohibited. For example, some constitutions prohibit parties that are founded on a tribal or group identity.
topics.question: Does the constitution prohibit one or more political parties?
topics.fa_def: برخی احزاب، یا احزابی با ایدئولوژی یا ویژگی معین، ممنوع‌اند؛ مثلن احزابی که بر پایه‌ی هویت قبیله‌ای یا گروهی بنا شده‌اند.

topics.definition_en: Establishes the boundaries of acceptable activity, or the organizational structure, of political parties. For example, parties may be bound to respect some fundamental principles of the state.
topics.question: Are there any restrictions or regulations placed on parties?
topics.fa_def: مرزهای فعالیت مجاز یا ساختار سازمانی احزاب را تعیین می‌کند؛ مثلن احزاب باید برخی اصول بنیادین کشور را محترم بدارند.

topics.definition_en: Establishes the right to join a party or other political organization, or gives citizens the right to form new political parties.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to form political parties?
topics.fa_def: حق پیوستن به حزب یا سازمان سیاسی، یا تشکیل حزب تازه.

topics.definition_en: Describes which branch or body of the government has the power to regulate political parties, particularly those tasked with determining the unconstitutionality of certain parties.
topics.question: Who is given the power to make determinations of unconstitutional political parties?
topics.fa_def: تعیین می‌کند کدام نهاد حکومتی بر احزاب نظارت دارد، به‌ویژه برای تشخیص مغایرت احزاب با قانون اساسی.

topics.definition_en: Grants groups and individuals the right to bring petitions to the government. This includes the right to bring complaints about the actions of the government.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right of petition?
topics.fa_def: حق افراد و گروه‌ها برای فرستادن عریضه و شکایت به حکومت، از جمله درباره‌ی کارهای خود حکومت.

topics.definition_en: An introductory section which may or may not be considered an enforceable part of the constitution.
topics.question: Does the constitution have an introduction or preamble?
topics.fa_def: بخش آغازین قانون اساسی، که ممکن است بخشی الزام‌آور از آن دانسته شود یا نه.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals who have been arrested and charged with a crime the right to be released from custody until the time of their trial. This may require paying the court a sum of money to be repaid at the time of the trial, or other conditions for release.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right/possibility of pre-trial release?
topics.fa_def: حق متهم بازداشت‌شده برای آزادی تا زمان محاکمه، گاه با سپردن وثیقه یا شرایطی دیگر.

topics.definition_en: Requires that those adjudicating a criminal trial maintain the posture that the accused is "innocent until proven guilty." This places the burden of proof on the side of the prosecution in the trial.
topics.question: Is there a presumption of innocence in trials?
topics.fa_def: دادگاه باید متهم را تا اثبات جرم بی‌گناه بداند؛ بار اثبات بر دوش دادستانی است.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals, especially journalists and publishers, the right to free expression through all forms of media. In many jurisdictions this includes a protection against prior censorship.
topics.question: Does the constitution prohibit censorship?
topics.fa_def: حق افراد، به‌ویژه روزنامه‌نگاران و ناشران، برای بیان آزاد در همه‌ی رسانه‌ها، که در بسیاری نظام‌ها منع سانسور پیشین را هم در بر می‌گیرد.

topics.definition_en: May invoke particular triumphs or tragedies in the country's past. Situates the constitution in the country's larger legal and political identity.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to social, political, or economic conditions in the time before the birth of the state or in the time of a former constitution?
topics.fa_def: یاد کردن از پیروزی‌ها یا فاجعه‌های گذشته‌ی کشور و جای دادن قانون اساسی در هویت حقوقی و سیاسی آن.

topics.definition_en: Usually in the context of specifying the new regime's treatment of these crimes. May grant amnesty or require punishment.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention anything about crimes committed by the previous regime?
topics.fa_def: معمولن تعیین می‌کند نظام تازه با جرایم رژیم پیشین چه می‌کند: عفو یا مجازات.

topics.definition_en: Requires that the state produce a public registry of the names of those imprisoned. This often serves as a check on arbitrary or unjust imprisonment.
topics.question: Does the constitution require that the names of those imprisoned be entered in a public registry?
topics.fa_def: دولت باید فهرستی عمومی از نام زندانیان تهیه کند، که اغلب مهاری بر زندانی کردن خودسرانه است.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals protection against government intrusion into their property, papers, person, or communications without proper authorization. Also protects against such intrusions by private individuals.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right of privacy?
topics.fa_def: حمایت از افراد در برابر ورود بی‌مجوز حکومت، و نیز اشخاص خصوصی، به اموال، اسناد، جسم یا ارتباطاتشان.

topics.definition_en: May bar legislators from engaging in other occupations during their term in office. Limitations might include prohibitions on holding some or all other public offices, or engaging in private business.
topics.question: Does the constitution require that legislators give up any other profession (i.e. work exclusively as legislators)?
topics.fa_def: ممکن است نمایندگان را در دوران نمایندگی از پیشه‌های دیگر، از جمله دیگر مناصب عمومی یا کسب‌وکار خصوصی، منع کند.

topics.definition_en: Allows individuals and corporations the sole ownership of real property, effects, financial instruments, or other objects. This right is in some cases open to violation in the interests of the community.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to own property?
topics.fa_def: حق مالکیت انحصاری افراد و شرکت‌ها بر زمین، اموال، اوراق مالی و دیگر دارایی‌ها؛ این حق گاه به سود جامعه محدود می‌شود.

topics.definition_en: Gives citizens a general right to work, and/or obligates the state to provide work. This is distinct from the right to choose one's occupation.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention a state duty to provide work/employment?
topics.fa_def: حق کلی شهروندان به کار، یا وظیفه‌ی دولت در فراهم کردن کار؛ جدا از حق انتخاب شغل.

topics.en: Duty to join a political party
topics.definition_en: Requires all citizens to be a member of a political party, or of the sole political party of the state.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to a duty to join a political party?
topics.fa_def: همه‌ی شهروندان باید عضو یک حزب، یا تنها حزب کشور، باشند.

topics.definition_en: Specifies whether the legislature is to conduct its business in public or in private. When legislative sessions are generally public, some constitutions may also specify the conditions (if any) under which the legislature may hold private sessions.
topics.question: Does the constitution prescribe whether or not the meetings of the legislature are (generally) held in public?
topics.fa_def: تعیین می‌کند مجلس کار خود را علنی انجام دهد یا غیرعلنی، و گاه شرایط برگزاری جلسه‌ی غیرعلنی را.

topics.definition_en: Requires that a written record of the deliberations of the legislature be published.
topics.question: Is a record of the deliberations of the legislature published?
topics.fa_def: انتشار صورت مکتوب مذاکرات مجلس را الزامی می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals charged with an offense the right to have their trial held in public.
topics.question: Does the constitution generally require public trials?
topics.fa_def: حق متهم به برگزاری علنی دادگاهش.

topics.definition_en: The legislature is only permitted to conduct its business, especially to vote on legislation, when a certain percentage of its members are present.
topics.question: Is a quorum required for a session of the legislature to be official?
topics.fa_def: مجلس تنها با حضور درصد معینی از اعضا، به‌ویژه برای رای‌گیری بر قوانین، رسمیت دارد.

topics.definition_en: Reference to the wireless transmission of audio programs, usually in the context of regulation.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to radio?
topics.fa_def: اشاره به پخش رادیویی، معمولن در زمینه‌ی مقررات.

topics.definition_en: Establishes the level of transparency in legislative voting. This could be a matter of public record, always kept secret, or varied depending on the topic of the vote.
topics.question: Are votes in the legislature a matter of public record, secret, or both (depending on the topic)?
topics.fa: علنی یا مخفی بودن رای نمایندگان
topics.fa_def: میزان شفافیت رای‌گیری در مجلس را تعیین می‌کند: ثبت عمومی، همیشه مخفی، یا بسته به موضوع.

topics.definition_en: Provides citizens an opportunity to vote for or against a specific piece of proposed legislation. Referenda are proposed by one or more bodies of the government.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the ability to propose a referendum (or plebiscite)?
topics.fa_def: فرصت رای موافق یا مخالف شهروندان به قانونی پیشنهادی، که یک یا چند نهاد حکومتی آن را به همه‌پرسی می‌گذارند.

topics.definition_en: Reference to a group of states, a geographical region, or an intergovernmental organization, such as the European Union.
topics.question: Does the Constitution mention a broader regional group of which the nation is a part?
topics.fa_def: اشاره به گروهی از کشورها، منطقه‌ای جغرافیایی یا سازمانی میان‌دولتی مانند اتحادیه‌ی اروپا.

topics.definition_en: Religious law and constitutional law interact in complex ways. Constitutions can treat religious law as entirely separate, integrated to some degree, applied in areas where secular law is silent, considered superior, or used as a source or inspiration for secular law.
topics.question: What is the status of religious law?
topics.fa_def: قانون اساسی ممکن است شرع را کاملن جدا بداند، تا اندازه‌ای در خود جای دهد، در جاهای سکوت قانون عرفی به کار بندد، برتر بشمارد یا منبع قانون‌گذاری قرار دهد.

topics.definition_en: Religious organizations are granted a special status with regard to taxation. This may include exemptions from regular taxation of income or property.
topics.question: Are religious organizations granted tax free status?
topics.fa_def: نهادهای دینی از نظر مالیاتی جایگاهی ویژه دارند، مانند معافیت از مالیات بر درآمد یا دارایی.

topics.definition_en: Procedures for removing individual members of the legislature for crimes or malfeasance. In some cases this action is taken by the legislator's chamber.
topics.question: Are there provisions for removing individual legislators?
topics.fa_def: روال برکناری یک نماینده به‌سبب جرم یا تخلف، که گاه به دست خود مجلس انجام می‌شود.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to just remuneration or fair/equal payment for work. May also regulate wages including the establishment of a minimum or living wage.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide the right to just remuneration, fair or equal payment for work?
topics.fa_def: حق دستمزد عادلانه یا برابر برای کار، و گاه تعیین کمینه‌ی دستمزد یا دستمزد کافی برای زندگی.

topics.definition_en: Primarily concerned with the movements of foreign nationals, describes the powers of the government to restrict entry into or exit out of the state.
topics.question: Does the constitution restrict entry or exit of the states borders?
topics.fa_def: اختیار حکومت برای محدود کردن ورود به کشور یا خروج از آن، بیش‌تر درباره‌ی اتباع خارجی.

topics.definition_en: Describes ownership of natural resources in general, or makes specific references to ownership or use of energy, mineral, water, flora, fauna, or other natural resources.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to ownership or possession of natural resources (such as minerals, oil, etc.)?
topics.fa_def: مالکیت منابع طبیعی به‌طور کلی، یا مالکیت و بهره‌برداری از انرژی، معادن، آب، گیاهان، جانوران و دیگر منابع.

topics.definition_en: Explains circumstances under which the rights of some individuals or groups may be restricted.
topics.question: Does the constitution specifically restrict the rights of any of the following groups?
topics.fa_def: شرایطی را برمی‌شمارد که در آن حقوق برخی افراد یا گروه‌ها محدود می‌شود.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to work in environments free of preventable hazards. This may include an obligation on the state to provide safe working conditions, or to address violations thereof.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention the right to safe/healthy working conditions?
topics.fa_def: حق کار در محیطی بدون خطرهای پیشگیری‌پذیر، و گاه وظیفه‌ی دولت در تامین شرایط ایمن.

topics.definition_en: Reference to science, which may include prioritization of investment in scientific research, or mandate state support for science and innovation.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to science or the sciences?
topics.fa_def: اشاره به علم، گاه با اولویت سرمایه‌گذاری در پژوهش یا الزام دولت به پشتیبانی از علم و نوآوری.

topics.en: Right to enjoy the benefits of science
topics.definition_en: Accords individuals the right to enjoy the benefits of scientific progress, or obligates the state to promote scientific advancement for the benefit of society.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to enjoy the benefits of scientific progress?
topics.fa_def: حق افراد برای بهره‌مندی از پیشرفت علمی، یا وظیفه‌ی دولت در پیش بردن علم به سود جامعه.

topics.definition_en: Addresses secession or withdrawal of groups or territories of the state. In cases where secession is allowed, usually also specifies the legal process that must take place.
topics.question: Are there provisions for the secession or withdrawal of parts of the state?
topics.fa_def: به جدایی گروه‌ها یا بخش‌هایی از کشور می‌پردازد و اگر آن را مجاز بداند، معمولن روال قانونی آن را هم تعیین می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Establishes a group right to self determination. This may be a reference to the nation as a whole, to groups in other countries, or to a portion of the state's population.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a people's right of self-determination?
topics.fa_def: حق گروهی تعیین سرنوشت، خواه برای کل ملت، خواه برای گروه‌هایی در کشورهای دیگر، خواه برای بخشی از جمعیت کشور.

topics.definition_en: Guarantees separation between the state and religious organizations. The state may be forbidden from extending governmental recognition or assistance to religious organizations.
topics.question: Does the constitution contain an explicit decree of separation of church and state?
topics.fa_def: تضمین جدایی دولت از نهادهای دینی؛ ممکن است دولت از به‌رسمیت شناختن یا یاری رساندن به نهادهای دینی منع شود.

topics.definition_en: The number of days or months that the legislature meets within a year.
topics.question: For how long are legislators in session during each year?
topics.fa_def: شمار روزها یا ماه‌هایی از سال که مجلس تشکیل جلسه می‌دهد.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to adequate shelter or housing. Often framed in terms of facilitating family life.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right to shelter or housing?
topics.fa_def: حق برخورداری از سرپناه یا مسکن مناسب، که اغلب در پیوند با زندگی خانوادگی بیان می‌شود.

topics.definition_en: Forbids the practice of owning or otherwise exploiting human beings. May still allow for compulsory labor as a punishment for a crime, and/or compulsory service in the military in time of war.
topics.question: Does the constitution prohibit slavery, servitude, or forced labor?
topics.fa_def: منع مالکیت یا بهره‌کشی از انسان؛ ممکن است کار اجباری به‌عنوان مجازات جرم یا خدمت نظامی اجباری در زمان جنگ را همچنان مجاز بداند.

topics.definition_en: Explicit references to social class. This may be in the context of either outlawing or providing for a system of social classes within the state, or in the context of pursuing socio-economic equality.
topics.question: Does the constitution have any of the following provisions with respect to social class?
topics.fa_def: اشاره‌ی صریح به طبقه‌ی اجتماعی، برای منع یا پیش‌بینی نظام طبقاتی یا در راه برابری اجتماعی و اقتصادی.

topics.definition_en: Considered one of the fundamental values of many states. Often mentioned in the preamble as a motivation for the constitution.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to 'fraternity' or 'solidarity'?
topics.fa_def: از ارزش‌های بنیادین بسیاری از کشورها که اغلب در مقدمه به‌عنوان انگیزه‌ی قانون اساسی می‌آید.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals charged with an offense the right to be brought to trial without any undue delay.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for the right to a speedy trial?
topics.fa_def: حق متهم به محاکمه بی‌تاخیر ناروا.

topics.definition_en: Special legislative processes for spending bills, which may include restrictions on proposal, approval, or amendment. Spending bills refer to legislation specifically for the expenditure of government money.
topics.question: Who can initiate spending bills?
topics.fa_def: روال ویژه‌ی قانون‌گذاری برای هزینه کردن پول عمومی.

topics.en: Right to reasonable standard of living
topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to a standard of living that sustains human dignity. May also refer to adequate well-being, suitable existence, or life worthy of a human being.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to an adequate or reasonable standard of living?
topics.fa_def: حق سطحی از زندگی که کرامت انسانی را پاس بدارد، یا رفاه کافی و زندگی شایسته‌ی انسان.

topics.definition_en: Establishes permanent committees with oversight in given policy areas, which often exercise legislative authority when the legislature is not in session. May also specify how members of these committees are selected, and how long they serve.
topics.question: Does the constitution specify a 'standing committee'?
topics.fa_def: کمیسیون‌های دائمی ناظر بر حوزه‌های سیاستی، که اغلب در زمان تعطیل مجلس اختیار قانون‌گذاری دارند؛ گاه شیوه‌ی گزینش و مدت عضویت آن‌ها را هم تعیین می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals and groups the right to cease work for a period of time, in an effort to exert pressure on their employer. This may or may not include protection for the jobs of strikers.
topics.question: Does the constitution provide for a right to strike?
topics.fa_def: حق افراد و گروه‌ها برای دست کشیدن از کار برای فشار بر کارفرما، که ممکن است حمایت از شغل اعتصاب‌کنندگان را هم در بر بگیرد یا نگیرد.

topics.definition_en: Specifies the competencies of the governments of the subsidiary units in a federal system.
topics.question: What is the name given to the subsidiary units?
topics.fa_def: صلاحیت‌های حکومت واحدهای زیرملی، مانند ایالت‌ها یا استان‌ها، را در نظام فدرال مشخص می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Establishes the competencies of the supreme court, other than adjudication and review of legislation. Such powers may include supervision of elections, impeachment of the executive, review of treaties, or other specified functions.
topics.question: What additional powers does the highest ordinary court have besides reviewing legislation?
topics.fa_def: صلاحیت‌های دیوان عالی جز دادرسی و بازبینی قوانین، مانند نظارت بر انتخابات، محاکمه‌ی مقام‌های اجرایی یا بازبینی معاهده‌ها.

topics.definition_en: A description of the system of government that the constitution is intended to create. Could be a description of the structure of the state, or of the political system.
topics.question: What does the constitution call the type of government that is envisioned?
topics.fa_def: وصف نظامی که قانون اساسی برپا می‌کند، چه ساختار کشور، چه نظام سیاسی.

topics.definition_en: Special legislative processes for tax bills, which may include restrictions on proposal, approval, or amendment. Tax bills refer to legislation specifically for collecting revenue for public use, usually in the form of taxes or tariffs.
topics.question: Who can initiate tax bills?
topics.fa_def: روال ویژه‌ی قانون‌گذاری برای گردآوری درآمد عمومی، معمولن به‌صورت مالیات یا تعرفه.

topics.definition_en: Requires all citizens to contribute to the expenses of the state through taxes. This is usually a general statement and may still allow for variation on the basis of income.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to a duty to pay taxes?
topics.fa_def: همه‌ی شهروندان باید با پرداخت مالیات در هزینه‌های کشور سهیم باشند؛ معمولن حکمی کلی است و تفاوت بر پایه‌ی درآمد را مجاز می‌داند.

topics.definition_en: Reference to wired or wireless communication, and the industries that support it, usually in the context of regulation. Includes telephones, satellites, the internet, and other communication technologies.
topics.question: Is there a mention of telecommunications?
topics.fa_def: اشاره به ارتباطات باسیم و بی‌سیم و صنایع آن، معمولن در زمینه‌ی مقررات؛ از جمله تلفن، ماهواره، اینترنت و دیگر فناوری‌های ارتباطی.

topics.definition_en: Terrorism specifically mentioned, usually in the context of the criminal justice system, or with regard to the activities of the military or other public safety bodies.
topics.question: Is there special mention of terrorism and public security provisions regarding terrorism?
topics.fa_def: اشاره‌ی صریح به تروریسم، معمولن در زمینه‌ی دادرسی کیفری یا کار ارتش و نیروهای انتظامی.

topics.definition_en: Forbids the state from torturing individuals, and in some cases from using coerced statements in court.  This prohibition may be limited in cases of war or other circumstances.
topics.question: Does the constitution prohibit torture?
topics.fa_def: دولت نمی‌تواند کسی را شکنجه کند و گاه نمی‌تواند از اقرار اجباری در دادگاه بهره ببرد؛ این منع ممکن است در جنگ یا شرایطی دیگر محدود شود.

topics.definition_en: Temporary sections of the constitution that guide the transition from the previous system to the current constitutional order.
topics.question: Does the constitution contain any transitional provisions?
topics.fa_def: بخش‌های موقت قانون اساسی که گذار از نظام پیشین به نظم تازه‌ی قانون اساسی را راهبری می‌کنند.

topics.definition_en: Grants the right to dispose of property through sale, gift, private wills, or other means.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention the right to transfer property freely?
topics.fa_def: حق واگذاری دارایی از راه فروش، هبه، وصیت یا راه‌های دیگر.

topics.definition_en: The steps that the government must follow to gain approval for accession to a treaty. Commonly this involves gaining the consent of part or all of the legislature.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention international treaties?
topics.fa_def: گام‌هایی که حکومت برای پیوستن به معاهده باید بردارد، که معمولن رضایت بخشی از مجلس یا همه‌ی آن را لازم دارد.

topics.definition_en: This especially concerns the status of treaties with regard to the constitution or ordinary law, and determines whether treaties are superior or inferior to the constitution or ordinary law.
topics.question: What is the status of treaties vis a vis the constitution?
topics.fa_def: جایگاه معاهده‌ها در برابر قانون اساسی یا قانون عادی: برتر یا فروتر.

topics.en: Trial in native language of accused
topics.definition_en: Grants individuals charged with an offense the right to have their trial conducted in a language they understand, or the right to have an interpreter. In some cases, this would include a right to be informed of the reasons for one’s arrest.
topics.question: Does the constitution specify the trial has to be in a language the accused understands or the right to an interpreter if the accused cannot understand the language?
topics.fa_def: حق متهم به دادرسی به زبانی که می‌فهمد یا داشتن مترجم؛ گاه حق آگاه شدن از دلیل بازداشت را هم در بر می‌گیرد.

topics.definition_en: A special commission tasked with hearing testimony and gathering evidence about human rights violations and other crimes, usually committed by a previous regime. Testimony given in such a commission may or may not be protected from use in future prosecutions.
topics.question: Does the Constitution provide for a commission for truth and reconciliation?
topics.fa_def: کمیسیونی ویژه برای شنیدن شهادت و گردآوری شواهد درباره‌ی نقض حقوق بشر و دیگر جرایم، معمولن به دست رژیم پیشین؛ ممکن است شهادت‌ها در پیگردهای بعدی به کار رود یا نرود.

topics.definition_en: Reference to the wireless transmission of audio-visual programs, usually in the context of regulation.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to television?
topics.fa_def: اشاره به پخش تلویزیونی، معمولن در زمینه‌ی مقررات.

topics.definition_en: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained to be eligible to serve as a representative in the second chamber of the legislature. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
topics.question: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of the second chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن نمایندگی در مجلس دوم و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: Names the office that presides over the second chamber of the legislature. This function might be fulfilled by a member of the chamber, the deputy executive, or another official.
topics.question: Who presides over the second chamber?
topics.fa_def: مقامی را که ریاست مجلس دوم را بر عهده دارد تعیین می‌کند: یکی از اعضای آن، معاون رئیس قوه‌ی مجریه یا مقامی دیگر.

topics.definition_en: Specifies the proportion of the seats in the second chamber that must be assigned to representatives of a particular group, such as women, ethnic groups, political parties, religious groups, or social classes.
topics.question: Does the constitution stipulate a quota for representation of certain groups in the second chamber?
topics.fa_def: نسبتی از کرسی‌های مجلس دوم که باید به نمایندگان گروهی معین، مانند زنان، گروه‌های قومی یا دینی، احزاب یا طبقات اجتماعی برسد.

topics.definition_en: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a representative in the second chamber of the legislature. These often concern residency, proficiency in the official language, or prior occupation.
topics.question: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of the second chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شرایطی که نامزد عضویت در مجلس دوم باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی اقامت، تسلط بر زبان رسمی یا پیشه‌ی پیشین.

topics.definition_en: The total number of seats in the second chamber of the legislature.
topics.question: How many members compose the second chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شمار کل کرسی‌های مجلس دوم.

topics.definition_en: Describes the procedure through which members of the second chamber of the legislature are elected or appointed. This is often different from the selection procedure used for the first chamber.
topics.question: How are members of the second chamber selected?
topics.fa_def: روال انتخاب یا انتصاب اعضای مجلس دوم، که اغلب با شیوه‌ی گزینش مجلس نخست فرق دارد.

topics.definition_en: Names specific areas of legislation that are a special concern for the second chamber. This may include sole authority to legislate in these areas.
topics.question: In regards to specific policy/substantive areas of legislation, are there any restrictions on, or special privileges reserved for, the second chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: حوزه‌هایی از قانون‌گذاری که به‌طور ویژه بر عهده‌ی مجلس دوم است، گاه با اختیار انحصاری.

topics.definition_en: The number of years that a representative in the second chamber of the legislature serves before reelection, reappointment, or dismissal is required.
topics.question: What is the maximum term length for members of the second chamber of the legislature?
topics.fa_def: شمار سال‌هایی که عضو مجلس دوم پیش از انتخاب یا انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری خدمت می‌کند.

topics.definition_en: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a representative in the second chamber of the legislature.
topics.question: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms members of the second chamber may serve?
topics.fa_def: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند عضو مجلس دوم باشد.

topics.definition_en: Some provisions in the constitutions may be so fundamental to the constitutional order, or so politically contentious, that they are designated as unamendable. In such cases, unamendable provisions are expressly noted in the constitution.
topics.question: Are any parts of the constitution unamendable?
topics.fa_def: اصولی که چنان بنیادین یا مناقشه‌برانگیزند که صریحن تغییرناپذیر اعلام شده‌اند.

topics.definition_en: Procedures for examining whether the content of a piece of legislation is in accord with the constitution. This may or may not be permissible prior to the promulgation of the legislation.
topics.question: What proportion of the vote of the court is required to find legislation unconstitutional?
topics.fa: بررسی مطابقت قوانین با قانون اساسی
topics.fa_def: روال بررسی سازگاری محتوای قانون با قانون اساسی، که ممکن است پیش از توشیح قانون مجاز باشد یا نباشد.

topics.definition_en: Grants the victims of crime rights in the justice process. These rights may include attendance at the trial, an opportunity to speak at the trial, restitution, or other measures to address the needs of crime victims.
topics.question: Is there a special mention of victims rights in the constitution?
topics.fa_def: حقوق قربانیان جرم در فرایند دادرسی، مانند حضور در دادگاه، سخن گفتن در آن، جبران زیان یا تدابیر دیگر.

topics.definition_en: Even where voting is considered to be a universal right, there may be some qualifications. For example, restrictions on the basis of residency, age, or criminal convictions are common.
topics.question: Does the constitution place any restrictions on the right to vote?
topics.fa_def: حتا جایی که رای حقی همگانی است، ممکن است قیدهایی مانند اقامت، سن یا محکومیت کیفری داشته باشد.

topics.definition_en: The right to vote is held by all citizens. There may nevertheless be some restrictions on voting by residency, age, residency or criminal conviction.
topics.question: Does the constitution make a claim to universal adult suffrage?
topics.fa_def: همه‌ی شهروندان حق رای دارند، هرچند ممکن است قیدهایی بر پایه‌ی اقامت، سن یا محکومیت کیفری باشد.

topics.definition_en: The process that the government must follow in order to establish a declaration of war. For example, this could be a power of the head of state, of the cabinet as a whole, or it could require consent from the legislative branch.
topics.question: Who has the power to declare war?
topics.fa_def: روالی که حکومت برای اعلام جنگ باید طی کند: اختیار رئیس کشور، اختیار هیات وزیران، یا نیاز به رضایت مجلس.

topics.definition_en: Grants individuals the right to water. May include a guarantee of safe, clean, or potable drinking water. Often associated with a state duty to provide or protect water as a resource.
topics.fa_def: حق برخورداری از آب، گاه با تضمین آب آشامیدنی سالم و پاک؛ اغلب با وظیفه‌ی دولت در تامین یا حفاظت از آب همراه است.

topics.en: Principle of no punishment without law
topics.definition_en: Protects individuals from being prosecuted for actions that were not crimes at the time they were committed. Similarly, the sentence imposed cannot be greater than the one that was mandated at the time that the crime was committed.
topics.question: Does the constitution mention nulla poena sine lege or the principle that no person should be punished without law?
topics.fa: اصل قانونی بودن جرم و مجازات
topics.fa_def: کسی برای کاری که هنگام انجامش جرم نبوده است پیگرد نمی‌شود و مجازات نمی‌تواند از آن‌چه در آن زمان مقرر بوده است سنگین‌تر باشد.

topics.definition_en: Requires individuals to contribute to the betterment of their society through work. This is usually a general statement and may still allow for variation on the basis of disability, age or other factors.
topics.question: Does the constitution refer to a duty to work?
topics.fa_def: افراد باید با کار به بهبود جامعه یاری رسانند؛ معمولن حکمی کلی است که بر پایه‌ی معلولیت، سن یا عوامل دیگر استثنا می‌پذیرد.
